checks: Standalone Blazor WASM starts from static hosting with no renderer Node runtime or desktop path UI.
The actual OS folder picker grants a live external vault, including binary attachment inventory.
Real CodeMirror typing and Ctrl+S preserve exact UTF-8 BOM, CRLF and Unicode in the original file.
External LF/CRLF changes reconfigure CodeMirror without changing the next save's line-ending style.
The shared note-creation UI creates folders and writes a new Markdown note directly to disk.
Desktop-only plugins are unavailable and Node-dependent plugins fail visibly without executing past require.
Core enablement and the unchanged upstream sample plugin save settings into the selected vault.
Page reload reconnects an IndexedDB directory handle and restores layout, core state and exact disk content.
External edits refresh clean buffers; stale saves fail without overwriting disk or discarding unsaved text.
A real page reload is blocked while a buffer has unsaved changes.
Cancelling the native folder picker retains the selected vault and dirty buffer.
Vault switching isolates core settings, and Create vault creates a real subfolder in the selected parent.
A new vault required explicit community-plugin opt-in, stored separately without creating or resetting an enabled-ID file.

Real shared Markdown postprocessors run in async sort order with matching document/source/frontmatter/section context and owned interactive controls; genuine classic HyperMD and the modern bridge agree before and after a following-line edit without changing source bytes.
Render-child removal and Reading/Source transitions unload actual component events; an asynchronous onload that finishes after removal is still cleaned up and its retained button cannot act.

Superseded asynchronous processors can only change their detached render section, stale section queries return null, and current processor errors are visible without rewriting or poisoning the next render.

Register/unregister and real plugin disable refresh unchanged Reading views and remove owned controls; a persisted disable survives restart/reconnect, re-enable works, and original Markdown BOM/CRLF plus other configured plugin IDs remain unchanged.

Actual plugin and factory code-block processors replace real fenced/nested code, await async handlers, preserve raw Unicode/HTML-like text and trailing blank lines, expose exact source/section context and own working controls; duplicate/invalid registrations reject without reserving a failed language.

Real MarkdownRenderer.render and deprecated renderMarkdown append independently owned formatted fragments without replacing prior DOM or opening hidden leaves, await actual handlers, provide null fragment-section context, sanitize note HTML and resolve a decoded vault image plus working source-relative link.

Static rendering waits for real asynchronous render-child loads; removing its DOM unloads controls, owner unload revokes the actual image URL, and a late processor can only mutate its detached section while a new render and disposed retained controls remain correct.

Async code-block failures reject and visibly retain original code while another block renders; invalid owners write no DOM, disable restores plain fences, re-enable/restart/reconnect removes language registrations correctly, and original Markdown/image bytes plus other enabled IDs remain unchanged.

Real detached title/wrapper children survive async construction and mutation delivery, become owned after replacement, unload if never inserted, and dispose waits for observer-started async native-style teardown; retained controls stop acting.

Unchanged Admonition 12.0.11 renders fenced titles and body Markdown, configured color values/icon SVG nodes, working open/closed controls and source-relative links; Source/Reading and disable/re-enable rebuild output. Native visual equivalence remains separate.

Configured Admonition survives full restart/reconnect, also renders through the actual static MarkdownRenderer API, and cleans static fragments on owner unload; note BOM/CRLF, supplied package bytes and unrelated enabled plugin IDs are preserved.
inputEnvironment: Windows occlusion and renderer/timer background throttling disabled in disposable UI processes; production launch is unchanged.
